text: {"label": "Safety Skills and Behavior-Based Safety","definition": "Teaching children and other learners to respond safely to hazards such as guns, dangerous stimuli and car restraints, plus behavior-based safety processes for preventing injuries in workplaces and process industries.","distinct_from_neighbours": "Covers safety broadly, from child safety skills to occupational safety, unlike the driving and traffic focus, child compliance with instructions, or behavioral skills training applied across varied skills."}
